0769 'Arnown {ar-no:n'} 或 'Arnon {ar-no:n'}

源自 07442; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Arnon 25; 25

亞嫩 = "湍急的溪流"
1) 南巴勒斯坦的一條河流及其周圍, 形成摩押和亞摩利人之間的邊界
record.edic_text:
0769 'Arnown {ar-nohn'} or 'Arnon {ar-nohn'}

from 07442;; n pr loc

AV - Arnon 25; 25

Arnon = "rushing stream"
1) a river and surrounding valley in south Palestine, forms the
   border between Moab and the Amorites
